verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://signoz.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a SigNoz summary, and docs pages are served as markdown (e.g. /docs/introduction/.md returns 200, and many doc URLs use .md). SigNoz also publishes an agent-oriented skill.md with Agent Skills that teach AI assistants to search its docs. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or of how completely llms.txt indexes the docs, and no independent community confirmation that agents use these docs successfully.
